notes: The machine of the verification (scripts/verify/README.md): copy this file to machine.json (ignored by git) and adapt it.
workRoot: the clones, the build cache by commit, the planets and the runs; never under %TEMP%, no space in it.
planets: planet files reused when terrain_probe --planet-check accepts them, only read and copied, never written.

linkContent: folders of Content linked (mklink /J) to the project of the user instead of copied, those nothing writes to (StylescapeHD 6.2 GB, Characters 4.9 GB); never TerrainEngine (the material scripts write there), Python (init_unreal.py of the copy) nor the folder of the map.
cmake: the path of cmake.exe when it is not in the PATH (tried first; then the PATH, then the cmake pip installed).
The driver always sets PlanetFile of the Terrain World of the map itself (the copy of a planet, or empty without it).
